name: skylark_add_known_traveler_number
intent: Add a known traveler number to a SkyLark flight trip
description: Opens My Trips in SkyLark Air, selects the trip for the requested city, enters the user's known traveler number from memory, and saves it.
patterns: Add my known traveler number to my trip
Put my known traveler number on my booking
Add my KTN to my trip
Save my known traveler number to my flight

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: City of the trip to update

steps.intent: Tap 'My Trips' to open the trips list
Tap the trip to {{trip_city}} in the list
Type {{user_known_traveler_number}} into the 'Known traveler number' field
Tap 'Save' to save the known traveler number
